title: Skin timing
caption: Skin cells renew on a fixed biological cycle — roughly 28 days in your twenties, slower as you age. That means any treatment targeting the skin's surface or deeper layers has to wait for that cycle to complete before the result is visible. It's why a practitioner saying 'come back in four to six weeks' is biology, not stalling. Understanding the cycle also tells you something useful: results that appear too fast are usually swelling or temporary inflammation, not the actual change.
